Thanks for the ping. For AP to process an ACH enrollment and change the remit-to account we need the following completed and returned:
- Completed ACH authorization form (attached)
- One of: voided company check OR bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account number and ACH capability
- Confirmation that the legal name on the W-9 matches the bank account ownership

I've attached our ACH_authorization_form.xlsx. Marta, if you can fill the form, sign, and either attach a voided check or upload the bank letter, we can start the enrollment immediately. Note on POs: if the urgent shipment is vendor-initiated and you need the ship-to to match immediately for a pending PO, we can do a temporary override on the PO-level ship-to (requester must approve). Olga — if you want me to do that, confirm which PO number(s) so I can place a hold and update the ship-to manually while the vendor record is validated.
